subject: Request: maintainer stipends + trial extension — Ark Collective
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina@arkcollective.org>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Maintainer stipends + short trial extension request

Hi David,

Thanks again for supporting the Ark Collective community last quarter — the maintainers found the trial environment really useful. We have a small follow-up ask: a handful of our project maintainers are running short on compute stipend for an upcoming sprint (names + roles attached), and we'd like to request a one-month trial extension for 12 contributor accounts so they can finish integration tests and demos for the event on July 8.

Quick context: our summer sprint will showcase integrations for open-data ingestion and low-latency serving; finishing the demos will materially increase contributor visibility and downstream adoption.

Would Redwood be able to: 1) top up a modest stipend pool (we estimate ~30k token-equivalent across maintainers) and 2) extend the existing 12-seat trial by 30 days? We can route the contracts and sign the MAP, but timing is tight — ideally we'd have approvals and access by June 16 so the maintainers can run a final test pass.

Attached: ark-project-roster.csv (maintainer list) and sponsorship-guidelines.pdf (program brief).

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if helpful.

—
Lina Park
Program Director, Ark Collective
lina@arkcollective.org
[attachment: ark-project-roster.csv] [attachment: sponsorship-guidelines.pdf]

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@arkcollective.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Maintainer stipends + short trial extension request

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. This is the kind of community program we want to back.

Quick answers: 1) We can provision a 30k token-equivalent stipend pool and allocate it across the maintainers in your roster. 2) We can approve a 30-day extension for the 12 seats on a short-term MAP (mutual action plan) that covers usage caps and a simple charter for demo support.

A couple of operational asks from our side to speed this through:
- Can you confirm the primary maintainer contact for billing and legal (name + email)?
- Please confirm the exact GitHub handles for the 12 contributors we should tie to trial seats (we can snapshot by handle).
- Any compliance or data-handling constraints for the demos (EU-only data, restricted datasets, PII)?

Marissa — I flagged this for you and Monica for program approval and to draft a short MAP. Monica, can your team prepare a quick MAP draft and the DocuSign link for signature? I pushed a tentative timeline: approvals by EOD June 15 and provisioning June 16.

Lina — if a 15–20 minute call helps, I'm free Jun 11 11:30–12:30 PT.

Thanks,

—
David Kim
Sales Lead, Developer & Community Programs
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0194

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Lina Park <lina@arkcollective.org>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Maintainer stipends + short trial extension request

Thanks David — following up with a proposed plan. Lina, copying the program ops owner Monica to handle the MAP and provisioning.

Proposal (summary):
- One-time stipend pool: 30k token-equivalent credited to a program account owned by Ark Collective. Credits will be consumable by the 12 named contributor accounts only.
- Trial extension: 12 contributor seats extended by 30 days starting 2027-06-16. Seats will be provisioned by GitHub handle and tied to an email.
- Program obligations: maintainers agree to a short showcase/demo on July 8 (public event) and provide a 1-page postmortem.
- Compliance: no EU-only restricted datasets in the trial environment; if needed we can discuss a restricted cluster in Redwood Private (separate conversation).

I attached a short MAP draft (proposed-map-draft.pdf) with the timeline and sign-off fields. Monica will prepare a DocuSign link once we get confirmation on the contact and handles from your roster.

Lina — can you confirm by EOD June 15 the definitive list of 12 handles and primary billing contact (name + email)? If we have that, Monica expects to generate the DocuSign and provisioning ticket for June 16.

On the credit accounting side: this will be recorded as a promotional credit (non-billable) tied to DEAL-87421 and the Ark Collective account.

—
Marissa Cole
Community Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: proposed-map-draft.pdf]

From: Lina Park <lina@arkcollective.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Maintainer stipends + short trial extension request

Hi Marissa, David — great, thanks so much. Confirming: I'll send the finalized 12 GitHub handles and the billing contact (Maya Ross, maya@arkcollective.org) by EOD today. We accept the MAP terms.

Please proceed with the DocuSign and provisioning workflow — expedited provisioning would be really appreciated.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on this — the maintainers are excited.

Best,
Lina
Program Director, Ark Collective
[attachment: none]
